verdict.rationale: Zulip documents a bot framework, a Botserver, and incoming-webhook integrations, so automation exists and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows product-native versioning, review, or rollback of those automations. Keeping custom bot code in a user's own source control would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
